note: PR #64, scripts/recalibrate.sh. Ran as a tool PR outside the roster, so this ledger is written retroactively at ship. NINE review rounds. Rounds 1-6 are recorded without per-round detail rather than reconstructed; only what was independently verified is written here.

blocking: CRITICAL-1: $(( PINNED + hr )) with PINNED unchecked. Bash coerces empty to 0 inside arithmetic, so --check printed 'pinned value is current' and exited 0 HAVING READ NO PINNED VALUE.
MEDIUM-1: `local hr` in the top-level loop printed a bash error on EVERY ceiling run -- direct proof the author had never run --check unpiped.

CRITICAL-1: a degenerate-but-integer measurement. A query that matches nothing returns 0; metric_well_formed ACCEPTED 0 and the self-test ASSERTED that acceptance; A=B=C=D=0 is the cleanest possible SOURCE_ONLY attribution. --write DESTROYED the pinned constant at exit 0 with 'installed file re-read and confirmed'. Same hole on the golden, leaving 0/0/0 'verified byte-identical'.
HIGH-1: the THIRD unanchored read (headroom). `let headroom = 1_000` read as 1.
HIGH-2: 7 of 17 mutants survived, including the one deleting round 5's own fix -- with it applied, --self-test printed 'all cases pass' while round 5's CRITICAL reproduced verbatim.
HIGH-3: the tool was wired to nothing.

events.note: 57 mutants, 47 killed. The reviewer was WRONG TWICE and the implementer caught both by measuring the prescription before applying it: the MEDIUM-2 fix was character-for-character the input already shipped (the mutant would have survived), and the 1_000 prescription preserved the anchors while DELETING the right anchor's only test.

65 mutants. No soundness hole. The finding was FOUR LIVE GUARDS WITH NO TEST -- one of them made untested BY THIS ROUND'S OWN FIX: MEDIUM-3's floor `[ pinned -ge 1 ]` errors on ''/abc/1_000, so round 5's four is_int cases reached the right verdict BY ACCIDENT. Only leading zeros discriminate, because bash's `[` reads 08 as decimal 8. The reviewer was wrong FOUR times; the implementer measured each prescription first and proved the E2 fixture produced byte-identical files under mutation.

verified.mutants: 61 applied, all compiled, all hashed. Four survivors, ALL PROVED EQUIVALENT rather than filed as gaps (R9 and S3 documented as such in shipped comments; F1 dominated by `total -eq 3`; P1 unreachable behind gate 1).
verified.decisive_control: with round 8's fix reverted AND its new cases removed, --self-test prints 'all cases pass', exit 0, ZERO stdout failures, 458B stderr. The empty-stderr assertion is the ONLY thing between that defect and a green suite.
verified.critical_still_closed: ceiling and golden predicates each broken to match nothing under --write: both exit 2, both tracked files byte-unchanged (hashed).
verified.cell_A_substitution: SOUND and stronger than argued -- cell A is main's binary over main's corpus under main's schema in a pristine detached worktree, more hermetic than a --check on a developer checkout.
verified.accidental_evidence: the reviewer's first run used the leaked octez-setup switch; the script printed 'baseline build FAILED -- refusing to measure a stale binary' and exited 2 rather than measuring. build_or_die firing for real.

events.first_real_exercise: Rebasing onto the new main put the tool in front of the event it was BUILT for, for the first time non-synthetically: #69 had just moved the ceiling 347 -> 349. It reported A=B=C=D=349, 'attributable to source change only (B = A)', 'within headroom: measures 349 against pinned 347 (+/-25) -- advisory, not stale', exit 0, stderr 0B. Every prior exercise was a predicate broken on purpose.

gates.golden: untouched -- the PR ships the tool without recalibrating anything
